packet_dag.terminal_condition: The packet is complete when reviewed class slides/worksheets/source sheets are represented as member-safe class assets, classroom media lazy-activates, member/classroom UI labels the material sections clearly, tests pass, and deployment/live smoke either passes or is blocked with evidence.

title: One Time Media Security And Class Materials

reasons: The operator asked for class-specific slideshows and worksheets beside videos.
The operator raised media-copying and download concerns.
Existing One Time asset storage already supports reviewed class materials, but slides are not first-class safe member assets yet.
likely_external_provider_blockers: Drive-to-Vimeo automated upload remains blocked by DEC-20260708-006.
Editable PowerPoint exposure policy remains a Rabbi/Shloimie decision under DEC-20260708-007.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After this packet, create the access-code UX packet or moderated-comments/update feed packet based on the next unblocked requirement.

operator_intent_summary: Make each One Time class page show the approved video, slideshow, worksheets, and source sheets in the right class context while applying honest member-only media security rules.
raw_quotes: have a section for the actual slideshow
along with the video the students are going to be able to see the slides themselves
we don't really want people to just take our AI videos
we need a section for the actual worksheets that are applicable to that specific class
out_of_scope: No Drive upload, Vimeo upload, Vimeo privacy mutation, Google Slides permission change, email/WhatsApp/Telegram send, payment/access grant, or public publish.
No implementation of comment publication, awards notifications, or classroom login/session rewrite.
No promise that browser-visible video or slides can be made impossible to copy, record, screenshot, or photograph.

inspection_targets: server.js One Time asset type normalization and public view filters
public/one-time-classroom.html today video and material rendering
observed: The member-safe public view exposes worksheet/source_sheet/example/other assets but not slideshow assets.
The classroom page eagerly mounts the today Vimeo iframe and shows a fallback Vimeo link.
The classroom page title area calls the main class panel Today / Live but does not split class-specific slides, worksheets, and source sheets.
Existing workflow docs already separate slideshows/source materials from recording transcription and external publishing.
known_blockers: Drive-to-Vimeo automation is blocked by DEC-20260708-006.
Editable PowerPoint exposure is blocked pending explicit acceptance; this packet uses member-safe view-only material links as the default.

trigger_phrases: worksheets applicable to that specific class

expanded_phrases.proper filters: Class material navigation must distinguish video, slides, worksheets, and source sheets without asking the user to infer which file belongs to which class.
expanded_phrases.slideshow: Approved slide assets must be first-class class materials and shown as view-only member-safe references by default.
expanded_phrases.worksheets applicable to that specific c: Worksheet and source-sheet assets must be attached to the same class_session_id and rendered only under that class/session.
expanded_phrases.security audit: The packet must state residual media-copying risks and enforce no raw Vimeo link or editable source-file exposure by default.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Use existing One Time class assets and member-library package snapshots as the first-party material model; keep external provider upload and permission writes behind separate approval.

requirements.expected_result: Approved slideshow or slide-deck assets are represented as member-safe class materials and can be viewed from the relevant class without exposing editable source files by default.
acceptance_criteria: One Time asset type normalization accepts slideshow and slide_deck.
Member-safe package snapshots and public views include approved slideshow assets.
Classroom material rendering separates slide materials from worksheets/source sheets.

requirements.statement: Show class-specific worksheets and source sheets in the classroom.
requirements.expected_result: Students/parents can see which worksheet/source-sheet materials belong to the selected class/session.
acceptance_criteria: The classroom page renders a Class Materials section for the today/selected class.
Worksheet and source-sheet labels are clear and tied to the class item.
Empty material states explain that reviewed materials will appear after approval.

requirements.statement: Apply honest media/material security policy in the UI and data path.
requirements.expected_result: The app avoids raw Vimeo fallback links and editable-source promises while documenting residual risks.
acceptance_criteria: Classroom video embeds lazy-activate after Play Video.
Vimeo media does not show a raw fallback link in classroom/member surfaces.
The register records that member-only/view-only delivery reduces casual copying but cannot stop screenshots or screen recording.

criteria: Raw intake RAW-20260708-006 and register exist.
Current-state audit and member-library performance packet are complete enough to isolate this slice.
External Drive/Vimeo/Google writes are explicitly out of scope.
The implementation uses the existing class asset/member-library snapshot model.
Editable PowerPoint files are not exposed by default.

findings.user_impact: The classroom mounted the primary video iframe before the member chose to play, adding unnecessary load to the classroom page.
findings.expected_fix: Lazy-activate the classroom video player only after Play Video.

findings.user_impact: Slides, worksheets, and source sheets were not presented as clear class-specific material groups.
findings.expected_fix: Render a compact Class Materials block under the active class with Slides, Worksheets, and Source Sheets groups.

accessibility.baseline: WCAG 2.2 A/AA plus responsive touch-target and no-overlap checks.
required_checks: Play Video button has visible text
Class Materials groups use text headings
Mobile material cards do not overflow
Security/residual-risk language is not the only access-control mechanism

action_states.label: View slides
action_states.handler_or_blocker: Opens approved member-safe slide asset URL in a new tab; source permissions are not mutated.

action_states.label: Open worksheet
action_states.handler_or_blocker: Opens approved member-safe worksheet/source-sheet asset URL in a new tab.

action_states.label: Drive to Vimeo automation
action_states.handler_or_blocker: Blocked by DEC-20260708-006 pending folder/account/token/privacy/rollback approval.

data_requirements: asset metadata for view-only/source policy when present

scope_rules: Only approved/published member-safe class assets are exposed to member/student classroom UI.
Transcript assets and admin-only notes stay hidden from the member-safe public view.
Vimeo items do not show raw fallback media links.
Slides default to view-only/member-safe asset links; editable PowerPoint files are not a default promise.
forbidden_content: raw video download link for Vimeo items
residual_risks: A member who can see video or slides can still use screen recording, screenshots, or another camera.
View-only Drive/Slides settings reduce casual copying but are not perfect DRM.
Provider-hosted privacy and domain restrictions need owner-approved external setup.

implementation_batches.scope: Classroom material support and safe video preview
instructions: Add slideshow and slide_deck to One Time asset type normalization and database check repair.
Include slideshow and slide_deck assets in member-safe snapshots/public views.
Render class materials in the classroom as Slides, Worksheets, and Source Sheets for the active class.
Lazy-activate the classroom video player after Play Video and do not show a raw Vimeo fallback link.
